claim: The fictional character may condition feeling okay about themselves on usefulness.
evidence_locator: source-excerpts.md S2; abstract, local extracted source line8

limitations: Independent reviewer: specific rest-guilt mechanism remains unverified; narration presents a qualified fictional application of a general model. Not a diagnosed or universal cause.
